purpose: size the matched validation benchmark before committing hours of engine time

machine.note: shared box; an unrelated ComfyUI python process holds ~8 GB of GPU memory

method: real G1 validation transition cases on ppo_729088, sampler seed 91001, timed from per-case episode.json mtimes so engine ramp-up is excluded from the steady-state figure

measurements.source: historical in-training evaluations, measured while PPO was also training on this box

measurements.note: only 1.9x faster than 2 workers despite 4x the workers; six of eight workers sat queued
no gain AT THIS WORKER COUNT, which led to the wrong conclusion that serialized startup was not the bottleneck; see the correction below
2.4x faster than 8 workers, but GPU reached 79 C against an 80 C ceiling

correction.why_it_looked_true: measured only at 8 workers, where few enough workers contend for the start slot that the extra slots go unused
correction.what_is_actually_true: the two settings interact: engine-start concurrency only pays off once enough workers are contending. The real launch at 12 workers with the DEFAULT single start slot and 3 s stagger ran at ~68 s/case with GPU at 2% and 12 workers blocked; the identical run with 4 slots and a 1 s stagger ran at 6.7 s/case with 11 engines live.
correction.cost_of_the_error: one misconfigured launch, caught after ~15 cases; the benchmark is resume-safe so the completed cases were kept

selected.reason: 12 workers with 4 start slots reached 6.7 s/case, better than the 16-worker probe, and plateaued at 79-80 C drawing ~165 W of a 300 W budget -- stable rather than climbing, and far below the throttle point. 16 workers offered no further gain worth the thermal headroom on a shared machine.

reliability_finding.trigger: HoloOcean OpenSemaphore handshake failure killed one pool worker
reliability_finding.consequence: a single engine failure aborts the entire benchmark sweep
reliability_finding.mitigation: tools/rl_final_campaign/run_matched_selection.py drives the benchmark in a resume loop; per-case results are persisted so a retry continues, and an attempt that adds no new cases stops the loop instead of spinning
